name: confiscate_excess
description: Guard confiscates excess fish and records violations

prompt.template:
You are acting as the lake guard. Please confiscate any excess fish from violations and record the violation.

Excess catches must be confiscated and recorded in the ledger.

Respond with ONLY this JSON object, nothing else:
{{"confiscated_catches": [{{"fisher": {{"agent_id": "<agent_id>", "amount": <number>}}}}], "reasoning": "<one or two sentences, in character>"}}
